name: maxxecu-tuning
description: Parse MaxxECU MTune datalogs (.MaxxECU-Zip-log, .MaxxECU-log, .maxxlog, .csv) and calibration files (.MaxxECU-save) natively on Windows to compute steady-state VE corrections, generate XML-verified .MaxxECU-save revisions, and audit fuel, ignition, knock, cold-start warmup, DBW idle & Fan-by-VSS curves, Cruise Control PID, and Dodge 8HP70/8HP90 CAN shift/torque setups.
suggestedPrompts: Review this MaxxECU MTune datalog and give me VE table and tuning recommendations
Audit my .MaxxECU-save tune file for fueling, spark, DBW idle, and safety limits
Review my Dodge 8HP70/8HP90 shift tables, torque model, and WOT shift cuts
Analyze my cold-start warmup log, DBW idle behavior, and Cruise Control PID
